body.label: Target
body.html: Self; choose a visible point within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, perceive ordinary sights and sounds from the point. Your body remains in place and aware; solid barriers block perception.

surges.html: Reveal one ordinarily concealed creature's occupied space within 1 unit of the point.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Familiar
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 1 Mana to enter Familiar Full Manifestation (FM-0F). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
